findings.title: Arm 'original' mixes adapted-goal runs: 601 of 702 original x gemini-2.5-pro banking/workspace logs carry the literal {optim_str} placeholder
findings.evidence: Attacked original-arm logs with '{optim_str}' in an injections value: 601/2,518 (expected 0). All in google_gemini-2.5-pro: banking 102/144 (11-12 per injection task), workspace 499/560 (35-36 per injection task); 0 in the other 13 original cells (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, Llama-3.1-70B, Qwen2.5-7B, gemini-3-pro, grok-4.1-fast; gemini-2.5-pro slack and travel). Both cells were added by 5cec9793 (2026-02-11). The literal comes from the fork's ADAPTED_GOAL (v1_2 banking injection_tasks.py adds ADAPTED_GOAL constants ending in {{optim_str}}), i.e. --adapted True runs filed under reruns/original; agentdojo.sh in the attack repository writes both runs to reruns/original (prereg section 9 lead).
